title: Experience sleeping in a tent in the sea of ​​clouds of Ta Xua

html:
In the early morning, visitors will be immersed in the sea of ​​clouds covering the mountain ranges or on the back of the dinosaur, visitors will blend in with the dawn on the plateau, a beautiful picture.

When traveling to Ta Xua, visitors should visit the scenic spot Dinosaur’s Back, many visitors choose to stay at a homestay, or set up a tent right on the back of the dinosaur to watch the sea of ​​clouds floating in the misty fog in the early morning.

The most beautiful thing is to welcome the sunrise on the back of the dinosaur with the sea of ​​clouds floating, many young people when traveling to Ta Xua often bring camping gear to sleep here overnight to watch the scenery of the sea of ​​clouds floating.

In the evening, if visitors camp overnight, remember to set up before 4:00 p.m., because the weather here often gets dark early, the climate of Ta Xua is quite cold at night, if you set up a tent, you should set it up firmly because the wind here is quite strong.

After a cool night, around 4-5am, visitors just open the tent door to enjoy the cool breeze and admire the beautiful scenery in the misty fog.

If you are planning to travel to Ha Giang, visit Ta Xua to admire the beautiful scenery, however, to enjoy hunting clouds in Ta Xua or admire the ripe rice color, visitors should go at the end of the year or the ripe rice color to be satisfied with the scenery of hunting clouds.

However, at the end of the year, when traveling to Ha Giang, visitors can also immerse themselves in the beauty of the purple buckwheat flower season, from the high altitude, visitors can see the beauty of the mountain ranges, winding mountain passes, corn fields or villages hidden in the misty fog.

Many visitors when camping in Ta Xua share that sleeping in a tent overnight is truly an unforgettable experience, on days when clouds cover the valleys, and can block the dawn, looking far away you will see the undulating mountain ranges.

Currently, the dinosaur spine is a cloud hunting spot sought after by many backpackers, a place to admire the magical sea. To be satisfied with the clouds, you should go from October to April of the following year, and the most beautiful is at the end of the year when the weather is hot, visitors will be afraid of showers or avoid floods in the highlands.

There are days when the clouds are thick from early morning to noon (10-11am), the clouds have not yet cleared, visitors will be satisfied with watching the clouds, if the day has less clouds, visitors can admire the scenery of the green mountains, the stilt houses nestled next to the mountains, the innocent children playing – A picture of the highlands.
